# Enable Sa2web MCP Access

## Goal

Let MCP-capable AI clients such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor read and operate Sa2web remote browsers.

## Preparation

- Node.js 20+.
- Install `@sa2web/mcp`.
- Prepare the agent login URL.
- The agent account has the required SaaS, workspace, inner site, and proxy permissions.

The `clientId` and `clientSecret` in the agent login URL must be treated as secrets.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @sa2web/mcp -g
npx playwright install --with-deps
```

After installation, these commands are available:

```text
sa2
sa2-browser
sa2-mcp
```

## Create an Agent User

Go to:

```text
User Management > Agent List
```

Add a new Agent user, such as `mcp-agent`, and save, as shown in @fig-add-agent.

![Sa2web add Agent user](/images/add-agent.png){#fig-add-agent}

The default password here is for manual frontend login at `https://<APP_DOMAIN>/app/login`. You can change this password by finding the Agent user in the user list, or by logging in to the frontend and changing it there. Agent usernames start with `a` by default.

After adding the user, you can see it in the Agent user list, as shown in @fig-agent-list.

![Sa2web Agent user list](/images/agent-list.png){#fig-agent-list}

Then copy the Agent user's `clientId` and `clientSecret` for MCP client configuration. You can also click the "![](/images/copy-agent-url.png){width=90px}" button to copy the login URL. The URL looks like this:

```text
https://192.168.1.105/agent/login?clientId=6d0593b03fa748aa8dee7452ef6221c8&clientSecret=d985786d946e4826aadd07d579c59b06bf41a32aff4a415f8981070915d940a9
```

It already contains `clientId` and `clientSecret`, so it can be used directly in MCP client configuration.

## Authorize the Agent User

Go to:

```text
User Management > Group List
```

On the group list page, create a new group, such as `agent`, as shown in @fig-agent-group. Click **Users**, add the Agent user such as `mcp-agent` to the group, and save. Then authorize the required SaaS, workspace, inner site, proxy, and other permissions for the group.

![Sa2web Agent group](/images/agent-group.png){#fig-agent-group}

Open the Agent login URL in a new browser, for example `https://192.168.1.105/agent/login?clientId=6d0593b03fa748aa8dee7452ef6221c8&clientSecret=d985786d946e4826aadd07d579c59b06bf41a32aff4a415f8981070915d940a9`. It redirects to the Sa2web home page, as shown in @fig-agent-auto-login. Confirm that the Agent's authorized content is correct.

![Sa2web Agent auto-login page](/images/agent-auto-login.png){#fig-agent-auto-login}

## MCP Client Configuration

Write configuration in the format required by the AI agent client you use. Example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "sa2-remote-browser": {
      "command": "sa2-mcp",
      "env": {
        "SA2_LOGIN_URL": "https://<APP_DOMAIN>/agent/login?clientId=...&clientSecret=...",
        "SA2_LOGIN_REDIRECT_PATH": "/app/login",
        "SA2_HEADLESS": "false",
        "SA2_IGNORE_HTTPS_ERRORS": "true"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The following example uses Codex desktop to show how to add Sa2web MCP. Click the `settings` menu in Codex, open the settings screen, as shown in @fig-codex-add-mcp, find `Plugins`, open the Plugins page, and click **Add MCP Server**.

![Add Sa2web MCP in Codex](/images/codex-add-mcp.png){#fig-codex-add-mcp}

Next, try this MCP. Enter the following prompt to use Sa2web MCP to browse a workspace site and collect content:

```text
Open the workspace 'demo2' using sa2-remote-browser, collect the main content of the page, and summarize it.
```

After sending the message, Codex uses `sa2-remote-browser` to access the Sa2web target site and collect content, as shown in @fig-mcp-demo.

![Sa2web MCP demo result in Codex](/images/mcp-demo.png){#fig-mcp-demo}

::: {.callout-warning}
Do not commit real `clientSecret` values to public Git repositories, screenshots, or public tickets.
:::

## AI Permissions

AI accounts are still controlled by the Sa2web permission system. Grant only what is needed:

- SaaS sites.
- Workspaces.
- Inner sites.
- Network/proxy access.
- Other necessary permissions.

The official documentation states that the target site is located in `iframe#rbi-frame`; the MCP Server controls that iframe through Playwright, and the agent does not directly access the target website.

::: {.callout-warning}
To reduce the risk of AI exposing trade secrets or private data, enable target URL protection for sites in the backend in advance, and hide or block SaaS account information, company-secret URLs, and sensitive keywords.
:::

## Acceptance Checklist

- [ ] `sa2-mcp` is in `PATH`.
- [ ] The MCP client can start it.
- [ ] The AI can only see authorized resources, and company secrets or information that must be hidden are hidden.
